description: pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs — check_revocation (lines 91-216) and check_revocation_against_anchor (lines 234-336) are almost identical 100-line functions. The only difference is whether the issuer identity comes from a Certificate or a TrustAnchor. Similarly in crl.rs. This violates DRY and makes bugs more likely (e.g., a fix applied to one method but not the other). Refactor: extract a helper that takes (issuer_subject: &Name, issuer_spki: &SubjectPublicKeyInfoOwned) and call it from both methods.
title: OCSP check_revocation duplicates full parse-verify-check logic with check_revocation_against_anchor
